info.title: local-llm-gateway
info.description: A local-first gateway in front of Ollama. Every error is `{ error: { code, message, hint?, request_id } }`: `code` is stable for programs, `message` and `hint` are written for people.

post.summary: Send a message and stream the answer
post.description: Server-Sent Events: `start`, then `delta`*, then `meta`, then `done`; or `error` (then `meta` and `done`) if the answer breaks after it started. Problems found before the answer starts (Ollama not running, model missing, conversation busy, queue full) are plain JSON errors, and nothing is saved.
